svg.title: Scenario 4: Player Turn — Warrior Uses Shield Bash, Stunning Goblin

g.text: Scenario 4: Player Turn — Warrior Uses Shield Bash, Stunning Goblin
Scenarios 4 and 5 occur within the same executePlayerTurn() call.
Warrior (SPD 30) acts first → Shield Bash stuns Goblin.
Goblin (SPD 25) acts second → is stunned, skips turn (Scenario 5).
This diagram focuses on the Warrior (player) phase.
